messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: ldlt functions
parts:
Marcus, Ben, or someone else, can you take care of the final few things so we can get this merged? I'm looking for a response with an estimate of time to completion (on the resolution of days).


From https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/pull/419#issuecomment-30100678:
Before this pull request gets in, these are the final things that need to be done:
- [ ] create a `check_ldlt_factor()` validation function or something like it.
- [ ] The distributions that create and use ldlt factor should use the check function and not throw directly from the distribution code itself. These are the ones I found:
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/inv_wishart.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/matrix_normal.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/multi_gp.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/multi_normal.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/multi_normal_prec.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/multi_student_t.hpp
    - src/stan/prob/distributions/multivariate/continuous/wishart.hpp
- [ ] For the unit tests written, make sure an `ASSERT_TRUE` is called with the `LDLT_factor::success` method so someone else writing additional functions with the LDLT_factor can use that as an example.
- [ ] Write at least one unit test for each of LDLT_factor and LDLT_alloc. Having an example in code of how to instantiate it will help immensely if we ever need to fix any of the code.
- [ ] remove any compiler warnings that are introduced in this branch (they're usually comparison between int and unsigned int warnings -- they show up in g++, but not clang++)

A lot of the headers and tests are getting moved, so it would be a lot less work to get this in soon.



Daniel
